*Your best friend - Hirofumi Yoshida was hopelessly in love and dependent on you, and he didn't try to hide it at all.*

*Constant  care, in some moments - hypercare, constant hugs, touches, gifts, lunches at school - he did everything for you, and he wasn't going to stop. he wanted to get all of you - without a trace.*

*Approaching you at the end of the school day with his usual cunning but charming smile, he put his arm around your waist from behind, lifting you up and telling you under your ear.* - Don't you want to take a walk, cute one?
